title: Effects of a Rehabilitation Treatment on Balance in PD Evaluated With a Stabilometric Platform
brief_summary: Pharmacotherapy with dopaminergic medications and deep brain stimulation cannot provide significant improvements in postural instability in Parkinson's disease, whereas previous reports of physical interventions have suggested promising results. The investigators want to study the effects of the multidisciplinary intensive rehabilitation treatment (MIRT) on balance disorders in Parkinson Disease (PD).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed with PD in stage 3 of Hoen \& Yahr according to the United Kingdom Brain Bank criteria.

Exclusion criteria:

Atypical parkinsonisms, patients with osteoarticular and muscular pathologies, PD patients with Mini Mental State Examination \< 26, patients with other disorders of balance.
study_population: 30 patients (12 M, 18 F, mean age 66,8 ± 8,7) diagnosed with PD in stage 3 of Hoen\&Yahr (mean UPDRS III 18.8±10.5) according to the UK Brain Bank criteria.
